Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original polished azərtur CUSTOMER TRIP PLANNER, consistent with approved reference image 1. This is a design proposal for an Azerbaijan inbound tourism website. Warm white #FAF8F4 background, charcoal #202624 text, restrained orange #EE7845 rectangular primary buttons with dark readable text, forest green #304B3D secondary controls and footer, pale sage #E6EBDC supporting panels. Manrope-like confident sans-serif headings and readable body type. 4px corners, thin rules, fine line icons, editorial whitespace and calm hierarchy. No pills, badges, eyebrow labels, neon, decorative gradients, fake reviews, discounts, maps, scarcity or instant availability claims. Do not style this as an AI chat app or an admin dashboard. Image1 is approved BRAND/STYLE reference, not edit target. Other images are project photographic assets to reuse faithfully. No unrelated stock imagery.
BUSINESS: customer may browse and configure without login; must sign in/register to submit a request. Operator checks availability and final quote before an offer. PDF contract preview/approval and initial deposit come AFTER confirmed offer, later payments are requested per service as due. No Pay now or Book now or payment card form in planner. No automatic contract acceptance. No universal refund percentage, no universal cancellation deadline. All rates are illustrative sample prices; final property/provider confirmed by staff. No fake booked state.
SINGLE CONSISTENT EXAMPLE: 2 travelers, 2 days / 1 night, 15–16 May 2027, From Into the highlands template, day1 Quba, day2 Khinalug and return via Quba to Baku. Only allowed destinations in controls: Baku, Quba, Khinalug, Gabala, Sheki. Do not draw fictional geographic maps. A straight schematic line Baku → Quba → Khinalug is fine. Add/remove day controls, maximum14days; connected-route choices only. Each tour/service is individually selectable.
EXACT SAMPLE PRICE ARITHMETIC: private car with driver 2 days × €90 = €180; Comfort stay 1 room ×1night×€110 =€110; English-speaking guide 2days×€65=€130; Airport transfer1×€35=€35; Local craft experience2travelers×€20=€40; total €495. These FIVE selected lines sum to €495, no additional tour base fee, no fixed deposit percentage, no balance countdown. The stay is an illustrative category, NOT a verified named hotel. All totals are group totals for2travelers. Optional Standard stay €65/room/night or Premium €190/room/night are alternatives, not added to Comfort.
Asset type: ONE COMPLETE full-length DESKTOP WEBSITE PAGE, desired1536pxwide ×3072pxtall, not a crop, no device frame, all sections and complete footer. 80px consistent horizontal margins. Image2 Khinalug village is scenic route imagery; image3 guesthouse terrace is illustrative stay photo; image4 hiking is optional small route image. Use photos selectively; this is a functional planning form, not another marketing homepage. No huge hero, no unrelated gallery.
